summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, containing its unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, MD&A, and a press release announcing a 195% sales growth and expanding DefendAir commercial momentum. The filing is a routine periodic report, not a special-situation event. No M&A, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity is present. The registrant reports a 29,162,475 shares outstanding and a cash position. This is a transparent operational update, so no deal terms apply.
